title: Portable document history archive manifest v1

revision.description: Canonical positive Int64 decimal string; the codec also enforces <= 9223372036854775807.

blobs.description: Sorted by sha256, with one entry per digest. Exactly the pinned head's reachable typed graph, neither omissions nor extras.

description: Stored as history.json in the bounded ZIP/ZIP64 archive profile. Host resource limits and cross-record/graph integrity are enforced by the codec in addition to this shape schema. Duplicate JSON properties are rejected.
